signal_labels.code: pickup code the customer read out
signal_labels.name_dob: name and date of birth match
signal_labels.name: name matches, no date of birth to corroborate

scoring: max(weight of matched signals), +4 if a second signal corroborates. NEVER a sum — summing name+sole+window reaches 134 and hands a stranger a bag.
auto_rule: conf >= 90 AND at least 20 points clear of the runner-up
ambiguity_rule: the same evidence on 2+ orders drops every one of them by 25 and caps them below AUTO
